composition.serve_who: This sheet (GMMS 108'-114b, "BILGE / WATER VALVE SYSTEM") wires five motor-operated Fresh Water valves (Fresh Water Valve, Fresh Water Port Bunker, Fresh Water Stbd Bunker, Fresh Water Port Suction, Fresh Water Stbd Suction) fed from breaker Q14 10A "WATER TRANSFER VALVES" via terminal strip T/S B and relays Re7-Re11. These are the register's 510-water-transfer-valves equipment (engineer mapping: WATER TRANSFER VALVES -> 510-water-transfer-valves; established fact confirms Q14 10A EMERGENCY POWER SUPPLY / EMERGENCY PANEL feed to this same node). Each valve's motor terminals 3/2 are driven from its own relay Re7-Re11, and each relay is commanded by an XA41 terminal (negative side, per engineer-settled q13/q15/q16/q82/q83/q84/q85) while XA60 terminals carry status-only signal to the Onyx monitoring system (652-onyx-monitoring cross-reference). No separate node exists for the bilge selection valves referenced in the owner's manual/inventory (Burkert 520-03) — those appear to be a distinct Burkert bilge product from 520-bilge-valves, not drawn on this sheet.

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Water Transfer Valves — Fresh Water Valve (motorised)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Load name 'FRESH WATER VALVE' matches engineer mapping WATER TRANSFER VALVES -> 510-water-transfer-valves; fed via T/S B terminal 14 branch off Q14 10A breaker, relay Re7.

functions.label: Fresh Water Valve open/close control loop
functions.what_it_does: Motor-operated valve that opens/closes the fresh water line; commanded by relay Re7 which is activated by its XA41 terminal (14→XA41 pin 10, on terminal 55) supplying the coil's negative; the relay then supplies positive to the valve motor (M) OPEN/CLOSE contacts, wired to motor terminals 3 (53) and 2 (54). XA60 terminals 02/04 land on terminals 51/52 (OPEN/CLOSE contact pins) and are status-only taps to the Onyx monitoring system, not commands.
functions.sheet_region: top block, T/S B terminals 51-55, relay Re7, ~y 0.16-0.20

flow_scenarios.path: Q14 10A (breaker, EMERGENCY PANEL) -> T/S B terminal 14 -> Re7 relay contact group -> motor terminals 53/54 idle until commanded
XA41 pin 10 -> terminal 55 -> Re7 coil negative -> relay energised -> relay supplies positive to OPEN or CLOSE contact (terminals 51/52) -> motor terminals 3/2 -> valve motor drives open or close
XA60 pins 02/04 tap terminals 51/52 (OPEN/CLOSE contact pins) -> status reported to Onyx monitoring, not a control input

functions.dry_data: 24V DC circuit, relay Re7, fed via Q14 10A breaker; motor-operated ball/gate valve actuator
